facts.title: Learn First Aid
facts.note: Secondary profession, no level requirement. Rawrk teaches to 150 (Journeyman at 50). In Forever First Aid also makes healing potions and cures for bleeds, disease and poison.

facts.title: Keep Linen Cloth
facts.note: Linen Bandage needs First Aid 30 in Forever, not 1; Heavy Linen is 50. Sources disagree on how the first points are made, so read the trainer's list.

facts.title: Camping 101: First Aid, then the First Aid Kit
facts.location: Quest giver not found for Horde
facts.note: First Aid 20. Kit is 3 Linen Bandage and 1 Refreshing Spring Water: a Stamina buff that does not stack with Power Word: Fortitude. Wowhead lists only the Alliance quest giver.

facts.title: The Great Outdoors, then Camping 101
facts.note: Brakk's quest comes first. Camping 101 aims at skill 20 in the profession.

facts.title: Basic Campfire (3 slots)
facts.note: Costs 1 Simple Wood. Sit 1 minute for the 1-hour buff; placing a fixture puts yours on a 1-hour cooldown.

facts.title: Fish Bowl, Camp Chair, Incense Candle
facts.note: +8% all stats, +2% crit, Intellect. You can place only one per hour, so the others need other players.
